The '''crystal cannon''' was a weapon used by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Sülphurr Cyander]]. During a [[Skirmish in Mos Espa|skirmish]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], Cyander used his crystal cannon to knock [[Ttekket]] out.
